# Load Packages
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(reticulate)
library(dplyr)
use_condaenv("samflow", required = TRUE)
```

```{python}
import os
os.environ["KMP_WARNINGS"] = "0"
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import scanpy as sc
import scipy.sparse
```

# Load Data
```{r}
source("samflow_functions.R")
samflow_load("filtered_feature_bc_matrix/")
```

# View Data
## R
```{r}
head(samflow_obj@meta.data)
```

## Python
```{python}
samflow_obj.obs.head()
```

# Normalize
```{r}
samflow_normalize()
```

## R — log-norm spot check
```{r}
# First 5 genes x first 3 cells from @data
as.matrix(GetAssayData(samflow_obj, layer = "data")[1:5, 1:3])
```

## Python — log-norm spot check
```{python}
# Same values — adata.X is now log-norm (cells x genes, transposed vs R)
import numpy as np

mat = samflow_obj.X[:3, :5]
if scipy.sparse.issparse(mat):
    mat = mat.toarray()
mat
```

## Python — raw counts preserved in layers
```{python}
# layers["counts"] should still have raw integer counts
raw = samflow_obj.layers["counts"][:3, :5]
if scipy.sparse.issparse(raw):
    raw = raw.toarray()
raw
```
